facts.value: terrace 88 ft (26.8 m) square x 6 ft (1.8 m), brick platform 20 ft (6.1 m) high, three gates S and three N, tiled pavilion on top (S02 p.107)

facts.value: 日下 j78:8a '永寧寺西為虎城 稍西為馬廏 再西為閲武樓' (額 詰戎揚烈). The emperor watched the cavalry from it.
